summary: SPX flat (+0.05%) and Dow +0.46% near records while NDX fell -1.15% into a Bearish regime on a semiconductor wreck (Intel -7.89%, XSD -5.55%). The 'sell chips, buy software' trade reappeared (IGV +1.01% vs SOXX -4.40%); capital rotated into software, telco, energy-services and cyclicals. SPX breadth positive 360/140 — a rotation, not risk-off. Alphabet raised AI capex again into growing bond-market payback anxiety ahead of megacap earnings and the Fed next week.
